about: One run per trial, named after it. Add a date called Trial ends to the run's values and the last three steps come to you on their days: two days before it charges, and the day after, to check. Change the date and they move with it.
name: Before a trial charges you

steps.about: Add a date called Trial ends to this run's values: the date in the confirmation email, not the one you signed up on. Nothing below comes round until it has a day.
steps.title: Say when it ends

steps.about: The amount and how often, from the same email. On the day you decide, it is here on the run.
steps.title: Write down what it will charge

steps.about: Not whether you meant to. Two days is enough to use it once on purpose and find out.
steps.title: Did you actually use it?

steps.about: One or the other, now. "Decide later" is the answer that charges you. The button opens the subscriptions this phone pays for through Apple; anything billed elsewhere is cancelled on its own account page.
steps.title: Cancel it, or write down what it is worth to you

steps.about: The confirmation, not the button. This is the step that catches the cancellation that needed a second page.
steps.title: Check it actually cancelled
